summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the 4 new features: Marketing Database, Unique Coupons, Campaign Scheduling and the bulk (fundle_campaign) SMS pipe config. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/iteration102_mdb_unique_sched_api_test.py (23 pytest cases, HTTP-level against the public preview URL) — 23/23 PASS after correcting bad test fixtures. Frontend: 3 Playwright runs covering the Marketing Database page (create/list/detail/member filter/run-campaign prefill/delete), the Coupons > Unique coupons tab (allocate/list/detail codes bound to mobiles/export CSV download/delete) and the Campaign wizard scheduling flow (Schedule button swap, scheduled row with sched-time/Launch now/Unschedule, revert to draft, delete). All flows PASS. One real integration bug found & fixed (mixed-content HTTP redirect on /segments). No campaign with a Karix template was ever launched; every created dataset/batch/campaign was deleted and verified gone from Mongo.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: UniqueCouponsPanel called api.get('/segments') (no trailing slash). FastAPI redirect_slashes returned a 307 to an absolute http:// URL, so the browser blocked it as Mixed Content ('insecure XMLHttpRequest endpoint http://.../api/segments/') and the segment list silently fell into the .catch() empty fallback. Changed to api.get('/segments/'); mixed-content errors now 0. NOTE: audit other api.get/post calls that omit a trailing slash on collection routes that only define '/' — same latent bug pattern.

design_issues.screen: Campaign wizard Review step + Unique coupon modal
issues: 'Schedule for later' (schedule-at-input) and the unique-coupon valid-from/valid-to fields use the native browser datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy, US format) instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere; also renders dates as 12/24/2026 while the rest of the app uses '22 Aug 2026' — inconsistent for an India-market product. Cosmetic only, functionality works.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): use the shadcn date/time picker + dd MMM yyyy formatting for schedule-at-input and unique-from/to-input instead of the native browser datetime-local control.

RECOMMENDED: grep the frontend for api.get/post('/<collection>') calls missing a trailing slash where the backend only defines '/' — each one becomes a blocked mixed-content 307 in the HTTPS preview (same root cause as the /segments bug fixed here).

HOUSEKEEPING: 4 stale campaigns from earlier iterations are stuck in status 'running' and therefore undeletable (TEST_Campaign_1779281588, TEST_Campaign_1779304771, TEST_sim_970a67, TEST_kx_f89ef6, all from May 2026). Simulated campaigns never transition out of 'running', so DELETE /api/campaigns/{id} always 400s for them. Consider a completion step for simulated campaigns or allowing force-delete.
critical_code_review_comments: marketing_db_routes.py GET /{mdb_id}/customers loads the entire mobiles array and resolves every member in memory before slicing the page — fine at the 200k cap for a one-off, but a 200k dataset means a full $in scan per page request. Consider caching the member flag on the dataset (recompute already exists) instead of recomputing on every page view.

coupons_routes.py _gen_unique_code uniqueness is only checked against the in-memory `used` set for the current batch — a code could collide with a code from a previous batch. There is no unique index on unique_coupons.code, so POS _lookup_pos_coupon on a colliding code would be ambiguous. Add a unique index on unique_coupons.code (and on marketing_databases.id / coupon_batches.id).
campaigns_routes.py /unschedule correctly $unsets schedule_at and gates on status=='scheduled' (400 otherwise) — verified. Delete of a 'running' campaign correctly 400s.
provider-config masks sms_campaign_api_key with bullet chars and never returns the raw key — verified good.

rca_of_the_issue: Mixed-content bug: FastAPI's redirect_slashes builds the redirect Location from the request scheme seen by the app (http, since TLS terminates at the k8s ingress). Requesting /api/segments (no trailing slash) from an HTTPS page therefore yielded a 307 to http://.../api/segments/, which Chrome blocks as insecure mixed content; the axios call rejected and the component's .catch(() => ({data:{rows:[]}})) hid the failure, leaving the Segment audience dropdown permanently empty. Fix applied: call the canonical path '/segments/' directly. Verified: 0 mixed-content console errors on re-run.
